title: SOC-Net: Second-Order-Cone-Constrained Neural Networks
abstract: arXiv:2611.34136v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: In many applications, neural networks must learn input-output maps that respect prior knowledge such as physical laws, safety requirements, and operating limits. These requirements constrain which outputs are admissible for a given input and often admit second-order cone (SOC) representations, including norm bounds and robust linear inequalities. Examples in control include friction cones, thrust bounds, and input-robust control barrier function (CBF) conditions. However, existing approaches to enforcing general input-dependent SOC constraints require a conic solver, an iterative scheme whose feasibility depends on convergence, or an interior feasible point for each input. We propose SOC-Net, a neural network architecture that enforces input-dependent SOC constraints by construction for every input, even outside the training distribution. translated_abstract: 在许多应用中，神经网络需要学习遵守先验知识（如物理定律、安全要求和运行限制）的输入-输出映射。这些要求约束了对于给定输入哪些输出是可容许的，并且通常可以表示为二阶锥（SOC）形式，包括范数界和鲁棒线性不等式。控制领域的例子包括摩擦锥、推力界以及输入鲁棒控制屏障函数（CBF）条件。然而，现有的施加一般输入依赖SOC约束的方法需要锥求解器、可行性依赖于收敛性的迭代方案，或针对每个输入的内部可行点。我们提出了SOC-Net，这是一种神经网络架构，它通过构造方式对每个输入强制执行输入依赖的SOC约束，即使在训练分布之外也能保证约束满足。SOC-Net将主干输出的仿射提升投影到固定乘积（原文截断）……
tldr: SOC-Net是一种通过构造方式对任意输入（包括训练分布之外的输入）强制满足输入依赖二阶锥（SOC）约束的神经网络架构，无需锥求解器、迭代方案或内部可行点。
en_tdlr: SOC-Net is a neural network architecture that enforces input-dependent second-order cone (SOC) constraints by construction for every input—even outside the training distribution—without requiring a conic solver, iterative scheme, or interior feasible point.
